Assess and propagate one discrete exposure-support prefix

Source: R/margot_lmtp_support_prefix.R
margot_lmtp_support_prefix.Rd

Evaluate the current conditional moment and, after a pass, optionally carry realised exposure ratios to the next assignment.

Usage

margot_lmtp_support_prefix(
  natural_mass,
  policy_mass,
  observed,
  preceding_weight,
  reached,
  row_id,
  minimum,
  observation_weight = NULL,
  excluded = character(),
  propagate = TRUE
)

Arguments

natural_mass, policy_mass

Numeric probability matrices. Rows have names equal to row_id; matching column names identify discrete values or regions with a common ratio within each region. Each reached row sums to one, within a tolerance of 1e-12. Each entry must lie in [0, 1] exactly; the tolerance applies only to the row sum.

observed

Named character vector of observed discrete values or region labels, matching the probability-matrix column names on reached rows.

preceding_weight

Named numeric vector of products of exposure ratios before this assignment. Use ones for the first assignment.

reached

Named logical vector marking the current observation risk set.

row_id

Unique nonempty character identifiers in input order.

minimum

Study-selected concentration threshold in (0, 1]. Equality passes. This is a decision convention, not a validity guarantee.

observation_weight

Optional positive, named inverse-observation weights. They are normalised over all reached records, including records with zero preceding exposure weight. NULL uses equal averaging weights.

excluded

Character vector of regions excluded by the policy by definition. Their policy mass must be zero on reached rows.

propagate

Whether to calculate realised ratios and next weights after a pass. Set FALSE at the last assigned wave when no propagation is needed.

Value

A list containing state, reason, concentration, diagnostics, realised_ratio and next_weight, with the supplied probability laws and observed categories. Invalid inputs return a reason and empty results. Failures after concentration retain the assessment and its diagnostics.

Details

A required zero natural mass fails the conditional-moment check. During propagation, an observed category with zero natural mass is allowed only when it is explicitly excluded by the policy. Otherwise propagation is unassessable. Rows with zero prior weight stay zero without division. With propagate = FALSE, callers must still report other_zero_mass in diagnostics, even if the conditional-moment assessment passes. This function does not choose or shorten a study's assignment schedule.

Examples

ids <- c("a", "b")
g <- matrix(c(.2, .8, .2, .8), 2, byrow = TRUE,
  dimnames = list(ids, c("zero", "positive")))
q <- g
q[, ] <- rep(c(1, 0), each = 2)
margot_lmtp_support_prefix(g, q, setNames(c("zero", "positive"), ids),
  setNames(c(1, 1), ids), setNames(c(TRUE, TRUE), ids), ids,
  minimum = .05, excluded = "positive")
